split_rule: md5("+".join(sorted(members))) mod 1000 < 300 → holdout (rich>=3 only); зафиксировано 20.11.2026 до M2/M3
M0_def: mean(mono) - addivnyi nul pri ravnykh dolyakh (vosproizvodit sertificirovannyi dR(rich) +0.7->+15 mM); pravka 20.11.2026 do M2/M3: sum daval -65 mM pri rich 10-15 (ne sootvetstvuet dizainu ravnoi plotnosti)
pair_resid_def: pair_obs - mean(mono_i, mono_j); вклад в M1 = r_ij * 4/k^2 (density-scaled, pravka 20.11.2026 do M2/M3: unscaled sum raskhoditsya pri high k)
